metadata.description: Lao language, typography and font design plugins by Deeoxide.

plugins.name: lao-typography
plugins.description: Lao (ພາສາລາວ) language, typography and font design for professional work: translation, proofreading and typesetting with Noto Sans Lao by default, Unicode and font fixes, OCR, spoken and written voice, web and graphic design, alphabet teaching, a Lao text checker, and a font studio that builds working TTF/WOFF2 fonts from a prompt.
